role: Development after failed confirmation; not independent validation
continuous_prior: Uniform three normalized physical parameters; balanced controller kind
discrete_prior: Uniform over sixteen actual historical behavioral profiles
likelihood: Raw-risk Gaussian discrepancy GP with shared covariance; per-family total variance from known-profile development predictor RMSE; half GP variance and half work observation variance
target_parameters: Never given to selector; historical descriptors and prior grid only
matched_information: All methods use the same newly fitted forward response model and historicalized training data
matched_history_gp: Previous best algorithm and kernel settings, sixteen conditional-model source responses, uniform source weights, risk-to-collision calibration refit on the same sixteen training profiles
matched_collision_gp: Same information-matched history GP, selecting collision score only instead of a budget-dependent risk/collision mixture
calibrated_behavior: Continuous behavior posterior with historical known-profile risk likelihood fitted GP discrepancy and work variance
calibrated_discrete: Discrete history posterior with the same fitted risk discrepancy
scope: Two controller kinds and three declared behavioral parameters
coverage_behavior: Same continuous behavior posterior; select expected C_i/N with zero gain when N=0, using 128-point Gauss-Legendre integration under conditional independent Bernoulli collision predictions
